meta.LevelUp: has accumulated 5 Experience, the player may choose an advancement available on their character sheet.

Sleeper.Title: Sleeper Advancement
Sleeper.Info: Your sleeping PC advances in the following steps:
Sleeper.OneToFive: They remember something about their Dark Secret.
Sleeper.Six: They awaken. You choose an Aware Archetype. The PC keeps their Dark Secret and their Disadvantages, but the player picks three Advantages from their new Archetype.

Aware.Title: Aware Advancement
Aware.Info: When your character advances you get to choose from the following advancements.
Aware.Four: Select a new Advantage from your Archetype.
Aware.Title2: After 5 Advancements You May Also Choose:
Aware.Six: Select a new Advantage from any Aware Archetype.
Aware.Seven: End your character’s story arc as you see fit, and create a new Aware character, who starts with 2 Advancements.
Aware.Eight: Replace your current Archetype with another Aware Archetype, and erase one of your starting 3 Advantages.
Aware.Title3: After 10 Advancements You May Also Choose:
Aware.Nine: Advance your character to an Enlightened Archetype.

Enlightened.Title: Enlightened Advancement
Enlightened.Info: When your character advances you get to choose from the following advancements.
Enlightened.Four: Gain an Ability available to your Archetype.
Enlightened.Title2: After 5 Advancements You May Also Choose:
Enlightened.Six: Gain an Ability or Advantage of your choosing.
Enlightened.Seven: Finish your character’s story and make a new PC.
Enlightened.Eight: Change your character’s Archetype to a new Enlightened one.
Enlightened.Title3: After 10 Advancements You May Also Choose:

StoryEnding.Title: The end of the story
StoryEnding.Explanation: Decide with the Game Master how this character’s story ends, then create the new character separately. This advancement records that decision; it does not create or modify another character.
StoryEnding.Confirm: Spend 1 Advancement Point to conclude this character’s story?
StoryEnding.Chat: {name} is bringing their story to a close.

Awakening.Title: Awakening
Awakening.DialogParagraph1: Attaining the Awakening is to achieve full liberation from the shackles of the Illusion and reacquire one's lost divinity.
Awakening.DialogParagraph2: Awakened beings transcend death, time, space and reality itself.
Awakening.DialogParagraph3: Awakened beings are no longer suitable as standard player characters in KULT: Divinity Lost.
Awakening.DialogParagraph4: Choosing this Advancement effectively ends this character's career as a Player Character.
Awakening.DialogParagraph5: The character becomes an NPC under the Game Master's control and transcends the normal rules of play.
Awakening.DialogConfirm: By choosing this Advancement you permanently retire this character as a Player Character. Are you sure you wish to continue?
Awakening.ChatParagraph1: {name} has begun the path toward Awakening.
Awakening.ChatParagraph2: Reality itself no longer holds the same meaning.
Awakening.ChatParagraph3: The boundaries of Time, Space and Death have started to unravel.
Awakening.ChatParagraph4: The character has left the realm of mortal Player Characters and is now considered an NPC.
